answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the timber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
